```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```


#read in intermediates
```{r}
s2_a <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp2/intermediates/s2_a.rds")
s2_b <- readRDS("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp2/intermediates/s2_b.rds")
```

```{r, fig.width=3}
s2_a_empty <- plot_grid(s2_a, NA, labels = c("a", ""), label_size = 7, nrow = 2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 1.0, rel_heights = c(1,0.3))
s2_a_empty
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
s2_complete <- plot_grid(s2_a_empty, s2_b, labels = c("", "b"), label_size = 7, ncol = 2, hjust = -0.8, vjust = 1.0, rel_widths = c(0.65,1))
s2_complete
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s2.pdf", plot=s2_complete,width = 8, height = 4)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/1_full_pds/s2.png", plot=s2_complete,width = 8, height = 4)
```
